BluePearl Pet Hospital – serving Lower Manhattan, 24/7.
Our downtown Manhattan location is one block from Union Square Park and we serve neighborhoods such as Chelsea, East Village, Flatiron District, Gramercy Park, Greenwich Village, Nolita, Soho, Tribeca and Union Square. We're off Fifth Avenue on West 15th Street and are accessible by public transportation.
Our reviews.
Find the most suitable emergency vet near you for prompt attention and care.
Recognizing emergency signs for pets.
At BluePearl Pet Hospital, we believe that identifying when your pet needs emergency veterinary attention is key to maintaining their health and well-being. From experienced veterinarians to efficient services, we cater to all. Look out for signs such as breathing difficulties, severe vomiting or diarrhea, inability to urinate, or a sudden collapse. Such symptoms may require emergency care. Trauma, like being hit by a car or other sudden incidents, merits immediate veterinary attention at an emergency animal hospital. In these instances, contacting your nearest emergency vet hospital and following their instructions is vital for your pet’s health. Remember, if in doubt about your pet’s condition, seek emergency veterinary advice at once.
Our services.
When your pet needs emergency care, our veterinary team near you is ready to provide immediate help. If your pet requires a specialist’s expertise, our veterinary hospital offers advanced medical care and treatment. Our pet hospitals near you ensure excellent veterinary care in every situation.
Our experienced team of veterinarians, vet technicians, and support staff work closely together to provide comprehensive, compassionate care for your pet's urgent needs.
In an emergency, call your BluePearl vet ahead and let us know you’re coming. No appointment is necessary for our emergency vet services; however, a prior call can help us offer better veterinary care.
Our veterinary specialists work directly with your primary care vet to understand your pet’s condition and develop the appropriate treatment plan that may include urgent care. Visits to our specialists are usually by referral from your primary care vet and by appointment. Learn more about veterinary specialists.
Caring for your pets is our passion. Meet our team of veterinarians here to help you and your pet.
Selecting the best emergency vet for your needs.
Choosing the right emergency vet is crucial for securing immediate and effective care for your pet’s urgent needs. Seek out hospitals offering 24/7 services with an experienced team of veterinarians and technicians at a well-equipped facility. Focus on hospitals renowned for their skilled staff and expertise in critical care situations. Reading reviews and getting recommendations can assist you in making the best choice for your pet's emergency needs, ensuring they receive the top-notch care they deserve.
Emergency
When you're bringing your pet to BluePearl for an emergency visit, preparation is essential to ensure excellent animal emergency care. Ensure you have your pet’s medical history, such as vaccination records and current medications, at hand. Calling ahead to our emergency team can provide them with important details about your pet’s condition, enabling them to prepare the necessary care prior to your urgent arrival. This proactive approach helps ensure a more efficient and less stressful experience for both you and your pet.

Experiencing an emergency vet clinic visit.
Upon arrival at BluePearl’s emergency clinic, our team prioritizes cases by the severity of their condition. BluePearl, as your go-to emergency animal hospital, ensures prompt medical interventions. Our veterinary staff triages animal patients, including dogs and cats, to identify who needs immediate care first, ensuring critical care for each. Be ready to share information about your pet’s symptoms, health history, and any recent incidents leading to the emergency. Keep in mind that the cost of emergency services can vary based on your pet’s condition and necessary treatments. The necessary wait may be reduced with prior appointment arrangements. Discuss financial aspects with our staff beforehand.

About BluePearl Pet Hospital Downtown NYC.
BluePearl has New York City covered with four hospitals. We have 24-hour emergency animal hospitals in Queens, Brooklyn and Midtown Manhattan, on duty and ready to care for your pet.
If you need a board-certified expert for a chronic condition, our specialty hospital in Downtown Manhattan is the boutique of the bunch, ready to treat all urgent care needs.
Our staff accommodates special requests, such as additional visits or phone updates, because pet owners in the Chelsea, Gramercy, and Greenwich Village areas want the very best emergency care for their animals.
